cues: Metaphor: a ribbon at a time.
The poem's only simile: the news like squirrels ran.
Personification: the hills untied their bonnets.
Antithesis between how the sun rose and how he set.
The allegory of the yellow children who become a flock.
A biblical allusion to the Good Shepherd, never named.
And enjambment: the sentence steps over the stanza break, just as the children step over the stile.
